name: Weinstadl
kurzbeschreibung: Heuriger with heurigen buffet, Tyrolean specialties and wine in Ebbs at the foot of the Kaiser Mountains.
beschreibung:
The Weinstadl is a heurigen tavern by Stefan Egger in Ebbs in the Kufsteinerland, Tyrol. It is located at Kaiseraufstieg 25 in Ebbs, on the edge of Kufstein directly opposite the ascent into the Kaisertal at the foot of the Kaiser Mountains. Drinks are ordered at the table, while guests select their dishes from the heurigen buffet.

The offering includes fresh salads, warm Tyrolean specialties, fried chicken, pork knuckle, schnitzel, roast beef and bacon snack, finished with Kaiserschmarrn and cheese from the Ebbser Käserei. In summer the beer garden invites you in. The establishment has 160 seats indoors and 130 outdoors. Open Wednesday to Saturday from 3 PM to 11 PM and Sunday from 12 PM to 7 PM, Monday and Tuesday are rest days.
